description.value: At 13th level, the white mage attains flexibility in metamagic knowledge. Once per day, as part of their meditation to regain lost MP, the white mage may gain the benefit of one metamagic feat that he doesn't possess. The white mage must meet the prerequisites of the metamagic feat. At 16th, once per day, the white mage is able to spend a full-round action to change the metamagic feat they selected at the beginning of the day for a different one. At 19th, they may exchange the metamagic feat twice per day.
